subject.title: fix(ui): Realtime Talk hangs when Google Live connections stall

question: Should Google Live Realtime Talk impose this fixed 30-second startup deadline, accepting that unusually slow but otherwise viable setup attempts will now fail and require retry?
rationale: The timeout is a deliberate availability-versus-latency product tradeoff rather than a mechanical correctness question, and the repository policy treats startup/fallback behavior as upgrade-sensitive.

options.title: Accept the bounded deadline
options.body: Keep the 30-second `setupComplete` deadline and merge after exact-head proof/checks confirm the final branch matches the reviewed behavior.

options.title: Use a different product policy
options.body: Request an owner-approved alternative such as a configurable or differently calibrated deadline before landing the transport change.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Defer this change if the product does not want a fixed failure deadline for slow Google Live startup.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded deadline
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-second `setupComplete` deadline and merge after exact-head proof/checks confirm the final branch matches the reviewed behavior.
